# Boxicons 2.1.4

This is the same pinned icon set used by the original Works top page (`index.html`: `https://unpkg.com/boxicons@2.1.4/css/boxicons.min.css`). CSS and font assets are copied without modification from the official npm package `boxicons@2.1.4` using `npm pack --ignore-scripts`. The original MIT LICENSE is retained. Local hosting avoids new CDN requests and keeps icons available with the application build. No React package or new icon system is introduced.
